Independent non-author exact-SHA documentation review: FAIL.

Reviewed final commit dce2e1c627478c6f2c762c2b4e1b813e83b4a2bf against exact parent 6dfc6d870024fa37ae3dd247bcea2b8c615d4284. The changed-path set is exactly the twelve declared infra/scripts paths.

Stage 1 — Spec compliance: PASS. The executable/configuration-line guard is byte-identical, the directive/shebang sequence and following-statement bindings are byte-identical (12 shebangs, one SC2016 directive, two gitleaks allowances, five mechanism-ok markers), and no undeclared path or non-prose hunk changed. The scope/consumer matrix below preserves every ticket-listed operational, security, recovery, monitoring, and operator contract.

Stage 2 — Documentation quality: FAIL against the strict per-block natural-word shrink rule used by this epic's independent receipts: (?u)\b[\w][\w’'-]*\b. The 310 executable-anchor-delimited edited prose slots shrink in aggregate from 28,687 to 5,546 words and from 195,507 to 42,226 characters, but aggregate shrink cannot satisfy the per-block criterion. Sixteen slots are not shorter by words; four of those also fail literal character shrink. In particular, the new mcp-entrypoint PID-1 comment has a zero-word baseline and cannot be a shrinking replacement. The replacement prose is semantically sound, but each listed row must be shortened below its own immutable parent baseline (or the zero-baseline addition removed) before approval.

Stage 3 — Domain integrity: PASS / not applicable. No executable line, identifier, state representation, control flow, configuration value, directive, or domain boundary changed.

Independent validation: 628 focused tests passed (238 autodeploy/host-cap, 260 observability/alarm, 122 MCP/op-cert, 8 review-bot). The worktree-venv config check, ShellCheck policy, make lint, make typecheck (770 source files), path-scoped git diff --check, executable-line guard, and directive-binding guard passed. Full local make verify was intentionally omitted under the documentation-only session direction; Gerrit CI remains the repository-wide gate.
